title: Config show record (v1)
description: The single compact, LF-terminated JSON object `config show --output json` writes: the winning credential source, the resolved config-file path, whether an effective credential exists, and which lower-precedence sources are shadowed. Presence and provenance only — the record never carries the credential, a fingerprint, a length, or any other reusable token material, so the schema pins every member with additionalProperties false.

source.$comment: The winning source's provenance name: an environment variable's spoken name, config file, or missing.

api_key_present.$comment: True exactly when an effective credential resolved — false only for the missing-everywhere case.

shadowed.$comment: The lower-precedence sources the winner overrides: the compatibility alias variable and/or the config file, in precedence order.
